description: RERUN clause (I-O-CONTROL) - the '85 checkpoint hint (RERUN [ON file/implementor-name] EVERY {{[END OF] REEL/UNIT | n RECORDS} OF f | n CLOCK-UNITS | condition-name}); no program-visible effect, parsed-and-ignored at 85 (a null rerun facility is conforming) once its five syntax rules are screened (COBOL6529-COBOL6531, kb/Work PB4945); deleted by ISO 2002 (absent from the whole 2023 text, 8.9 included).
citation: obsolete '85 checkpoint hint deleted by ISO 2002 (absent from the whole 2023 text; §2023:8.9 absence); parsed-and-ignored at 85; VCR Table 7 row 7.15
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.15; the W3 notInGrammar 85-acceptance batch (DEVLOG 599)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRR1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "vmrr" ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
I-O-CONTROL.
    RERUN ON SYSRR EVERY 10 RECORDS OF F.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT F.
    MOVE "CHECKPOINT" TO R.
    WRITE R.
    CLOSE F.
    STOP RUN.
